title: 13 people were killed from a gas leak at a chemical plant in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
text: Visakhapatnam is the largest and most populous city in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. It is between the Eastern Ghats and the coast of the Bay of Bengal.

title: Prime Minister, Narendra Modi announces the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.
text: Narendra Damodardas Modi is an Indian politician who has served as the prime minister of India since 26 May 2014. Modi was the chief minister of Gujarat from 2001 to 2014 and is the Member of Parliament (MP) for Varanasi.

title: Cyclone Amphan hit the eastern part of India and lead to flood like situation in many South-eastern states.
text: Super Cyclonic Storm Amphan was an extremely powerful and devastating tropical cyclone that caused widespread damage in Eastern India, specifically in West Bengal and Odisha, and in Bangladesh, in May 2020. It was the strongest tropical cyclone to strike the Ganges Delta.

title: A petroleum gas and oil leak occurred in Indian Oil's Baghjan Oilfield, in Assam.
text: Assam is a state in Northeast India, located south of the Eastern Himalayas along the Brahmaputra Valley and Barak River valleys. It covers an area of 78,438 km2, and is the second largest state in northeastern India by area.

title: A pregnant elephant died after eating a pineapple filled with firecrackers, in Palakkad, Kerala.
text: Elephants are the largest living land animals. Three living species are currently recognised: the African bush elephant, the African forest elephant (L. cyclotis), and the Asian elephant (Elephas maximus).

title: 2–4 June – Cyclone Nisarga hit the western coast of India, causing damage in the state of Maharashtra.
text: Severe Cyclonic Storm Nisarga was a tropical cyclone that struck the Indian state of Maharashtra in 2020. It was the largest cyclone to strike the state in June since 1891.

title: The President of India promulgates three ordinances related to agriculture, which would be later proposed as a bill and consequently passed as an act.
text: The Indian agriculture acts of 2020, often termed the Farm Bills, were three acts initiated by the Parliament of India in September 2020. The Lok Sabha approved the bills on 17 September 2020 and the Rajya Sabha on 20 September 2020.

title: Bollywood Star Sushant Singh Rajput found dead at his Bandra Residence in Mumbai.
text: Sushant Singh Rajput was an Indian actor best known for his work in Hindi cinema. Rajput is the recipient of several accolades, including a Screen Award and three Filmfare Award nominations.

title: India wins a two-year seat on the United Nations Security Council to begin 1 January 2021 during the 2020 Security Council Elections.
text: The United Nations Security Council is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations, and is the United Nations' executive branch, having primary responsibility for the maintenance of international peace and security. Its powers, outlined in the UN Charter, include establishing peacekeeping operations, authorizing military action, and imposing international sanctions.

title: 19 June–23 June – Death of P. Jayaraj and J. Bennix.
text: The arrest of shopkeepers P. Jayaraj and his son J. Bennix (also spelled Fennix, Benniks) (31 years old) by the Tamil Nadu Police in Sathankulam, Thoothukudi district on 19 June 2020 and their subsequent sexual and physical abuse in custody resulted in their deaths three days later. The incident sparked strikes and protests by Sathankulam shopkeepers against police brutality, attracting significant media coverage …

title: Indian Government bans 59 Chinese apps including TikTok, CamScanner, SHAREit and UC Browser due to the ongoing Sino-Indian Border tensions.
text: TikTok is a Chinese social networking service and short-form online video platform. It hosts user-submitted videos, which range in duration from three seconds to 60 minutes.

title: 8 Policemen of the Uttar Pradesh police are martyred in an encounter with the gang of the wanted criminal Vikas Dubey in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh state.
text: Kanpur, formerly anglicized as Cawnpore, is a large city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. Founded by Rajput ruler Hindu Singh Chandel, Kanpur became one of the most important commercial and military stations of British Raj.

title: CRPF convoy is attacked by terrorist which results in martyr of 1 CRPF soldier in Pulwama, Jammu and Kashmir.
text: Jammu and Kashmir is a region administered by India as a union territory consisting of the southern portion of the larger Kashmir region, which has been the subject of a border dispute between India and Pakistan since 1947 and between India and China since 1959.

title: Wanted Criminal Vikas Dubey encountered.
text: Vikas Dubey was a notorious Indian gangster-turned-politician, crime boss, mobster and history-sheeter from Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh particularly infamous for the Bikroo case in July 2020. He was commonly known as "Vikas Pandit", naming himself after the titular character of the 1999 film Arjun Pandit, played by Sunny Deol.

title: 2020 Amshipora murders. Indian military personnel were responsible for the killing of three Kashmiri laborers, after claiming they were terrorists.
text: The 2020 Amshipora murders, or the Amshipora fake encounter, or the Shopian fake encounter, refers to the killing of three alleged Kashmiri laborers, one of whom alleged to be a minor, by an Indian military personnel of the Rashtriya Rifles in the village of Amshipora, in the district of Shopian, in Jammu and Kashmir, on 18 July 2020. title: ongoing – Floods in Brahmaputra River in the state of Assam.
text: The Brahmaputra is a trans-boundary river which flows through Southwestern China, Northeastern India, and Bangladesh. It is known as the Brahmaputra in Assam, Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibetan, the Siang/Dihang River in the Mishmi language, and Jamuna River in Bangladesh.

title: National Education Policy 2020 (NEP 2020), a new policy on education in India approved by the Union Cabinet.
text: The National Education Policy of India 2020, which was started by the Union Cabinet of India on 29 July 2020, outlines the vision of 3D new education system of India. The new policy replaces the previous National Policy on Education, 1986.

title: 2020 Punjab alcohol poisoning. At least 121 people died after drinking toxic, illegally-made alcohol in Punjab.
text: The 2020 Punjab alcohol poisoning was an incident in late July and early August 2020, where at least 100 people died after drinking illegally-made toxic alcohol in Punjab, India. Hundreds of raids were conducted in the three affected districts - Amritsar, Gurdaspur and Tarn Taran - along with several other places in and around the Rajpura and Shambhu border in Punjab.

title: Air India Express Flight 1344 Crashed after overrunning the Runway at Calicut International Airport, Kerala. At least 19 people killed, including two pilots and 17 Passengers.
text: Kerala, officially Keralam, is a state on the Malabar Coast of southern India. It was formed on 1 November 1956 under the States Reorganisation Act, which unified the country's Malayalam-speaking regions into a single state.

title: Fire at a COVID-19 facility in the city of Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, killed 11 people and left 22 injured.
text: Coronavirus disease 2019 is a contagious disease caused by the coronavirus SARS-CoV-2. Starting in January 2020, the disease spread worldwide, resulting in the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: An idiopathic disease broke out in Eluru, Andhra Pradesh. On 20 December, AIIMS and NEERI Research Institute came to a conclusion that pesticides leaching into the water supply is the most likely reason.
text: Andhra Pradesh is a state on the east coast of southern India. The seventh largest Indian state by area and the tenth largest by population, it is bound by the Bay of Bengal to the east, and shares borders with the states of Odisha to the northeast, Chhattisgarh to the north, Telangana to northwest, Karnataka to the west, and Tamil Nadu to the south.
